note: Per-page titles and descriptions for the indexable marketing/docs pages.
Two consumers read this file and they must not be allowed to disagree:
scripts/build-release.sh bakes the title, description, canonical, og/twitter
tags, sitemap and markdown variants into each prerendered page, and
src/helpers/page_meta.rs reads the same titles so a client-side navigation
sets the browser tab to exactly what a cold load of that URL would show.
A route absent from `pages` is noindex, and falls back to the landing
page's title, which is the brand line and so is not written down twice.
Keep '/' first: the sitemap is emitted in this order. Search-result bands,
which build-release.sh fails the build over: title <= 60 characters,

/.title: PidgeIoT — Open-Source IoT Device Management
/.description: Open-source IoT device management: config push, OTA updates, telemetry graphs, GPS tracks, and email alerts for ESP32 and nRF91 fleets. Free while in beta.

/features/.title: IoT Platform Features — Shadows, Telemetry, OTA | PidgeIoT
/features/.description: Device shadows with report-back, telemetry with queryable history, email alerts, OTA firmware updates, device logs, and a remote diagnostic shell.

/how-it-works/.title: How It Works — Device to Dashboard in 5 Steps | PidgeIoT
/how-it-works/.description: How a reading travels from a device to your dashboard: provisioning and per-device keys, transports, telemetry reports, shadow convergence, alerts and OTA.

/use-cases/.title: Use Cases — Asset Tracking, Monitoring, OTA | PidgeIoT
/use-cases/.description: Five shapes of device fleet on one platform: GPS asset tracking, environmental alerting, remote firmware updates, bring-your-own-database, and small fleets.

/pricing/.title: Pricing — Free During Early Access | PidgeIoT
/pricing/.description: All of PidgeIoT is free during early access, no credit card required. Fair, simple pricing for larger fleets will come later — one product, one price.

/documentation/.title: Documentation — Connect Your First Device | PidgeIoT
/documentation/.description: How PidgeIoT works and how to connect a device: accounts, flocks, pigeons, tokens, shadows, telemetry, alerts, and over-the-air firmware updates.

/api-reference/.title: API Reference — Dashboard & Device HTTP APIs | PidgeIoT
/api-reference/.description: The complete PidgeIoT HTTP surface: dashboard routes, device routes, Ed25519 bearer tokens, shadows, telemetry, logs, firmware, and WebSocket frames.

/architecture/.title: Architecture — Edge-Native IoT, Rust End to End | PidgeIoT
/architecture/.description: How PidgeIoT is built: Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects at the edge, a WASM dashboard, managed PostgreSQL, and self-hosted Ory Kratos identity.

/getting-started/.title: Getting Started — Try It With No Hardware | PidgeIoT
/getting-started/.description: Go from zero to live telemetry in about ten minutes using a simulated Zephyr device on your own machine — no board, no radio, no hardware required.

/demo/.title: Live Demo — Real Device Data, No Signup | PidgeIoT
/demo/.description: Watch live telemetry from a real PidgeIoT device account right now: no signup, no mock data. Charts and latest values straight from the platform API.

/open-source/.title: Open Source — Licenses & Attribution | PidgeIoT
/open-source/.description: PidgeIoT is AGPL-3.0 and developed in the open. Full attribution and license texts for every open-source component the platform ships, auto-generated.

/about/.title: About — Justin's Engineering Services | PidgeIoT
/about/.description: PidgeIoT is built by Justin's Engineering Services, a small Massachusetts engineering company that got tired of IoT platforms punishing small fleets.

/contact/.title: Contact — Talk to the Team | PidgeIoT
/contact/.description: Questions about the platform, a fleet too big for the pricing page, or something that should work and doesn't: it reaches the same small team in Massachusetts.

/privacy/.title: Privacy Policy | PidgeIoT
/privacy/.description: What PidgeIoT collects, where it lives, and what we deliberately don't do with it: no selling data, no ad tracking, and no tracking cookies.

/terms/.title: Terms of Service | PidgeIoT
/terms/.description: The terms for using PidgeIoT during early access: acceptable use, account responsibility, licensing, and how changes to the service are communicated.
